name: gs_play
notes: Probe set curated against the real gs_play DB (2366 entries). extraArgs is EMPTY on purpose: the only clangd.arguments the extension wrote (D:/OffLocalDev/gs_play/.vscode/gs_play.code-workspace, settings block) is --compile-commands-dir=D:\OffLocalDev\gs_play\build\windows\clangd, and the harness supplies its own copy of that dir. D:/OffLocalDev/gs_play/.vscode/settings.json has no clangd.arguments, and neither does the user settings.json. No --query-driver is written for cl/clang-cl builds. The project part holds no C++ (all project C++ lives in its own gem), so probes use projectGem. Workspace gems = D:/OffLocalDev/gs_play_gems/<gem>/Code. gs_ai and gs_world are template stubs that are NOT in the DB (expectedBuilt false). VolumetricCloudsForO3DE is in the DB but under no part. Compare drive-letter case-insensitively (d:/ vs D:/ both appear in the DB). The nav stage uses nav.dbSubset so its index can finish; a full-DB gs_play index takes about 1.5 hours at jobs 4.
